---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m2p2t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Banks, Total
VARIABLES bal, phase, vote, txn, down

ASSUME Total \in Nat

RECURSIVE SumSet(_)
SumSet(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
             ELSE LET b == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE
                  IN bal[b] + SumSet(S \ {b})

NoTxn == [from |-> "none", to |-> "none", amt |-> 0]

TypeOK ==
    /\ bal \in [Banks -> 0..Total]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "collecting", "commit", "abort"}
    /\ vote \in [Banks -> {"?", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ down \subseteq Banks
    /\ txn.amt \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ bal = [b \in Banks |-> IF b = CHOOSE x \in Banks : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ vote = [b \in Banks |-> "?"]
    /\ txn = NoTxn
    /\ down = {}

Propose ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ \E s, r \in Banks, a \in 1..Total :
         /\ s # r
         /\ bal[s] >= a
         /\ txn' = [from |-> s, to |-> r, amt |-> a]
    /\ phase' = "collecting"
    /\ vote' = [b \in Banks |-> "?"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, down>>

Vote(b) ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ b \notin down
    /\ vote[b] = "?"
    /\ \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![b] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, phase, txn, down>>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ b \notin down
    /\ down' = down \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, phase, vote, txn>>

AllYes == \A b \in Banks \ down : vote[b] = "yes"

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ txn.from \notin down
    /\ txn.to \notin down
    /\ AllYes
    /\ bal[txn.from] >= txn.amt
    /\ bal' = [bal EXCEPT ![txn.from] = @ - txn.amt,
                          ![txn.to]   = @ + txn.amt]
    /\ phase' = "commit"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, txn, down>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ \/ \E b \in Banks \ down : vote[b] = "no"
       \/ txn.from \in down
       \/ txn.to \in down
    /\ phase' = "abort"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, vote, txn, down>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"commit", "abort"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ txn' = NoTxn
    /\ vote' = [b \in Banks |-> "?"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, down>>

Next ==
    \/ Propose
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Vote(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<bal, phase, vote, txn, down>>

Conservation == SumSet(Banks) = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
    Total = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A bank runs an interbank settlement batch where several member banks each hold a
balance of settlement funds. To move funds from one bank to another the system
uses two-phase commit: a coordinator proposes a transfer of some amount from a
sending bank to a receiving bank, then collects a vote from every participating
bank. Any bank can crash silently at any time, dropping out of the round without
warning. If every non-crashed bank votes yes and both the sender and receiver
are still up, the coordinator commits the transfer, debiting the sender and
crediting the receiver by the same amount. If any bank votes no, or the sender
or receiver has crashed, the coordinator aborts and leaves all balances
untouched. After a commit or abort the batch resets to accept the next transfer.
The total amount of settlement funds in the system is fixed at the start.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state the sum of all member bank balances
equals the fixed initial total, so no settlement funds are ever created or
destroyed by a proposal, vote, silent crash, commit, abort, or reset.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m2p1t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, MaxVer
VARIABLES ver, rec, stage, buf, vote, down

ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat

Vals == 0..MaxVer

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in Vals
    /\ rec \in Vals
    /\ stage \in {"idle", "voting", "committing", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ buf \in [base : Vals, val : Vals]
    /\ vote \in [Drones -> {"?", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ down \subseteq Drones

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ rec = 0
    /\ stage = "idle"
    /\ buf = [base |-> 0, val |-> 0]
    /\ vote = [d \in Drones |-> "?"]
    /\ down = {}

Begin(d) ==
    /\ stage = "idle"
    /\ d \notin down
    /\ \E nv \in Vals :
         buf' = [base |-> ver, val |-> nv]
    /\ stage' = "voting"
    /\ vote' = [x \in Drones |-> "?"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rec, down>>

CastVote(d) ==
    /\ stage = "voting"
    /\ d \notin down
    /\ vote[d] = "?"
    /\ \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![d] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rec, stage, buf, down>>

ExternalCommit ==
    /\ stage = "voting"
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ \E nv \in Vals : rec' = nv
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, buf, vote, down>>

Crash(d) ==
    /\ d \notin down
    /\ down' = down \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rec, stage, buf, vote>>

Reboot(d) ==
    /\ d \in down
    /\ down' = down \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rec, stage, buf, vote>>

Prepare ==
    /\ stage = "voting"
    /\ \A d \in Drones \ down : vote[d] = "yes"
    /\ Drones \ down # {}
    /\ buf.base = ver
    /\ stage' = "committing"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rec, buf, vote, down>>

Commit ==
    /\ stage = "committing"
    /\ rec' = buf.val
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxVer THEN ver + 1 ELSE ver
    /\ stage' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<buf, vote, down>>

Abort ==
    /\ stage = "voting"
    /\ \/ \E d \in Drones \ down : vote[d] = "no"
       \/ buf.base # ver
       \/ Drones \ down = {}
    /\ stage' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rec, buf, vote, down>>

Recycle ==
    /\ stage \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ stage' = "idle"
    /\ vote' = [d \in Drones |-> "?"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rec, buf, down>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Begin(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CastVote(d)
    \/ ExternalCommit
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Crash(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Reboot(d)
    \/ Prepare
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Recycle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<ver, rec, stage, buf, vote, down>>

NoLostUpdate == (stage = "committing") => (buf.base = ver)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2}
    MaxVer = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A wildfire surveillance swarm of drones shares one situation record that holds a
value together with a version number. When a drone wants to update the record it
opens a two-phase-commit round: it reads the current version as its base, drafts
a new value, and asks every drone to vote. While voting is under way a concurrent
committed update from elsewhere in the swarm can advance the shared version and
overwrite the record, which makes the in-flight base stale. Any drone may crash
silently and drop out of the round. The coordinator moves the round to the
committing stage only when every non-crashed drone has voted yes and the round's
base still matches the current version; if a drone votes no, if the base has gone
stale, or if all drones have crashed, the round aborts with no write. Once in the
committing stage the update is applied to the record and the version advances.
After a commit or abort the swarm recycles for the next round.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a round is in its committing stage, the version it read
as its base still equals the current shared version, so no update is ever applied
on top of a version it did not observe and no committed update is silently lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m1p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Locks
VARIABLES active, holder, inCS, want

ASSUME Locks \subseteq Nat

Above(h) == {m \in active : m > h}
NextActive(h) ==
    IF Above(h) # {} THEN CHOOSE m \in Above(h) : \A k \in Above(h) : m <= k
    ELSE CHOOSE m \in active : \A k \in active : m <= k

TypeOK ==
    /\ active \subseteq Locks
    /\ holder \in Locks
    /\ inCS \subseteq Locks
    /\ want \subseteq Locks

Init ==
    /\ active = Locks
    /\ holder = CHOOSE n \in Locks : \A k \in Locks : n <= k
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ want = {}

Request(n) ==
    /\ n \in active
    /\ n \notin want
    /\ want' = want \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, holder, inCS>>

Enter(n) ==
    /\ n = holder
    /\ n \in active
    /\ n \in want
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ inCS' = {n}
    /\ want' = want \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, holder>>

Exit(n) ==
    /\ n \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, holder, want>>

PassToken ==
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ holder' = NextActive(holder)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, inCS, want>>

Join(n) ==
    /\ n \in Locks
    /\ n \notin active
    /\ active' = active \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inCS, want>>

Leave(n) ==
    /\ n \in active
    /\ n # holder
    /\ n \notin inCS
    /\ Cardinality(active) > 1
    /\ active' = active \ {n}
    /\ want' = want \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inCS>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Locks : Request(n)
    \/ \E n \in Locks : Enter(n)
    \/ \E n \in Locks : Exit(n)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Locks : Join(n)
    \/ \E n \in Locks : Leave(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<active, holder, inCS, want>>

MutexViaToken == \A n \in inCS : n = holder
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Locks = {1, 2, 3}
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT MutexViaToken
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network arranges its locks in a token ring. A single
circulating token grants the exclusive right to reconfigure the shared keying
bus (the critical resource). Locks are numbered, and the token passes to the
next active lock around the ring. A lock may request the bus, and when it both
holds the token and has an outstanding request it may enter the critical
section; it later exits and frees the section. The token only advances while no
lock is in the critical section. The network's capacity changes at runtime:
a lock can join the ring at any time, and a lock other than the current token
holder and not currently in the critical section can leave the ring, provided
at least one lock always remains. The token holder is always an active lock.

Actions: request the bus, enter the critical section while holding the token,
exit the critical section, pass the token to the next active lock, join the
ring, and leave the ring.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every lock that is in the critical section is the current token
holder, so only the single token-holding lock can ever occupy the shared bus at
one time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m8p0t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Players, Slots
VARIABLES coarse, fine, editor, reqs

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Players \cup {None}
    /\ fine \in [Slots -> Players \cup {None}]
    /\ editor \in [Slots -> Players \cup {None}]
    /\ reqs \subseteq (Players \X Slots)

Init ==
    /\ coarse = None
    /\ fine = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ editor = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ reqs = {}

SendReq(p, s) ==
    /\ <<p, s>> \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {<<p, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, editor>>

AcquireCoarse(p) ==
    /\ coarse = None
    /\ coarse' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, editor, reqs>>

ReleaseCoarse(p) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ coarse' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, editor, reqs>>

AcquireFine(p, s) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ fine[s] = None
    /\ <<p, s>> \in reqs
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {<<p, s>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, editor>>

Enter(p, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = p
    /\ editor[s] = None
    /\ editor' = [editor EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, reqs>>

Exit(p, s) ==
    /\ editor[s] = p
    /\ editor' = [editor EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, reqs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : SendReq(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players : AcquireCoarse(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : ReleaseCoarse(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : AcquireFine(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : Enter(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots : Exit(p, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<coarse, fine, editor, reqs>>

MutexPerSlot == \A s \in Slots : editor[s] # None => fine[s] = editor[s]
=============================================================================
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker protects its shared match slots with a
two-level hierarchical lock: a single coarse lobby lock, then a fine per-slot
lock. A player who wants to edit a match slot must first acquire the coarse
lobby lock, then use it to acquire the fine lock on the specific slot, and only
then may it enter the slot's critical section to edit it. After grabbing the
fine lock a player releases the coarse lock so other players can proceed on
other slots. Lock-request messages travel over an unreliable channel and can be
delivered and processed in any order, so pending requests form an unordered set
that the matchmaker may service in any sequence.

Actions: send a lock request for a (player, slot) pair; acquire the coarse lobby
lock; release the coarse lobby lock; acquire a fine slot lock while holding the
coarse lock and having a pending request; enter a slot's critical section while
holding its fine lock; and exit the critical section, releasing the fine lock.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any player editing a slot's critical section holds that slot's
fine lock, so at most one player at a time can occupy any given match slot.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m7p0t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES reg, inCS, pend, epoch

None == "free"

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in Drones \cup {None}
    /\ inCS \subseteq Drones
    /\ pend \subseteq Drones
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch

Init ==
    /\ reg = None
    /\ inCS = {}
    /\ pend = {}
    /\ epoch = 0

Request(d) ==
    /\ d \notin pend
    /\ pend' = pend \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, inCS, epoch>>

CasAcquire(d) ==
    /\ d \in pend
    /\ reg = None
    /\ reg' = d
    /\ pend' = pend \ {d}
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED inCS

CasFail(d) ==
    /\ d \in pend
    /\ reg # None
    /\ pend' = pend \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, inCS, epoch>>

Enter(d) ==
    /\ reg = d
    /\ d \notin inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, pend, epoch>>

Exit(d) ==
    /\ d \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, pend, epoch>>

CasRelease(d) ==
    /\ reg = d
    /\ d \notin inCS
    /\ reg' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, pend, epoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Request(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CasAcquire(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CasFail(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Enter(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Exit(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CasRelease(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<reg, inCS, pend, epoch>>

InCSImpliesOwner == \A d \in inCS : reg = d
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Drones = {da, db}
    MaxEpoch = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT InCSImpliesOwner
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm guards access to a shared downlink channel
(the critical resource) with a single compare-and-swap register. The register
holds either "free" or the identity of the owning drone. Because control traffic
is unreliable, acquire and release requests can be reordered, so pending requests
accumulate in an unordered set the swarm services in any order. A drone requests
the channel; a compare-and-swap that observes the register free installs the
requesting drone as owner (advancing an acquisition epoch); a compare-and-swap
that observes the register busy simply fails and discards the request. Only the
owning drone may enter the downlink critical section, and it later exits and then
releases the register back to free.

Actions: request the channel, compare-and-swap to acquire when the register is
free, compare-and-swap that fails when the register is busy, enter the critical
section as owner, exit the critical section, and release the register.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every drone occupying the downlink critical section is the
current owner recorded in the compare-and-swap register, so no two drones ever
use the shared channel at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m6p5t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS Items, Robots, MaxT, LeaseLen
VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, log

None == "none"
Horizon == MaxT + LeaseLen
Range(s) == {s[i] : i \in DOMAIN s}

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ holder \in [Items -> Robots \cup {None}]
    /\ expiry \in [Items -> 0..Horizon]
    /\ log \in Seq(Items)

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = [i \in Items |-> None]
    /\ expiry = [i \in Items |-> 0]
    /\ log = << >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, log>>

GrantLease(r, i) ==
    /\ holder[i] = None
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![i] = r]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![i] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, log>>

Renew(r, i) ==
    /\ holder[i] = r
    /\ clock <= expiry[i]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![i] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, log>>

Expire(i) ==
    /\ holder[i] # None
    /\ clock > expiry[i]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![i] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, log>>

Dispatch(r, i) ==
    /\ holder[i] = r
    /\ clock <= expiry[i]
    /\ i \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, i)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

AdminDispatch(i) ==
    /\ i \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, i)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E r \in Robots, i \in Items : GrantLease(r, i)
    \/ \E r \in Robots, i \in Items : Renew(r, i)
    \/ \E i \in Items : Expire(i)
    \/ \E r \in Robots, i \in Items : Dispatch(r, i)
    \/ \E i \in Items : AdminDispatch(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<clock, holder, expiry, log>>

NoDoubleDispatch == \A a, b \in DOMAIN log : log[a] = log[b] => a = b
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Items = {p1, p2}
    Robots = {r1, r2}
    MaxT = 3
    LeaseLen = 1
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleDispatch
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet dispatches pallets from a loading dock. Ownership of a
pallet is governed by a time-limited lease: a robot is granted a lease on a
pallet that expires at a fixed horizon past the current clock, and the robot may
renew the lease while it is still valid. A global clock ticks forward. Once the
clock passes a lease's expiry the lease can be reclaimed and the pallet becomes
free again. Dispatching a pallet is irreversible: a robot holding a currently
valid lease on a pallet may append it to the dispatch log, but only if that
pallet has not already been dispatched. A privileged admin override may also
dispatch a pallet directly, bypassing the lease, but it likewise refuses to
dispatch a pallet that is already in the log.

Actions: tick the clock, grant a lease, renew a valid lease, expire a stale
lease, dispatch a pallet under a valid lease, and admin-dispatch a pallet.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No pallet ever appears more than once in the dispatch log, so
the irreversible dispatch of any given pallet happens at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m9p2t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Total, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES load, epoch, phase, slow

Cranes == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ load \in [Cranes -> 0..Total]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ phase \in {"stable", "reconfiguring"}
    /\ slow \subseteq Cranes

Init ==
    /\ load = [c \in Cranes |-> IF c = "c1" THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ phase = "stable"
    /\ slow = {}

Move(a, b) ==
    /\ phase = "stable"
    /\ a # b
    /\ a \notin slow
    /\ load[a] >= 1
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![a] = @ - 1, ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, phase, slow>>

BeginReconfig ==
    /\ phase = "stable"
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ phase' = "reconfiguring"
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, slow>>

Shift(a, b) ==
    /\ phase = "reconfiguring"
    /\ a # b
    /\ load[a] >= 1
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![a] = @ - 1, ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, phase, slow>>

EndReconfig ==
    /\ phase = "reconfiguring"
    /\ phase' = "stable"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, epoch, slow>>

MarkSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, epoch, phase>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, epoch, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a, b \in Cranes : Move(a, b)
    \/ BeginReconfig
    \/ \E a, b \in Cranes : Shift(a, b)
    \/ EndReconfig
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : MarkSlow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Recover(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<load, epoch, phase, slow>>

Conservation == load["c1"] + load["c2"] + load["c3"] = Total
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Total = 3
    MaxEpoch = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A container-ship crane yard balances a fixed number of containers across three
cranes. During normal operation a crane may hand one container to another crane;
a crane that is running slow is temporarily unable to originate such a handoff,
but it has not failed and will recover. The yard periodically reconfigures under
an epoch number: beginning a reconfiguration advances the epoch and enters a
reconfiguring phase, during which containers may still be shifted one at a time
between cranes to rebalance the yard, after which the reconfiguration ends and
the yard returns to stable operation. A crane can be marked slow and can later
recover.

Actions: move a container between cranes in stable phase (not from a slow crane),
begin an epoch reconfiguration, shift a container during reconfiguration, end the
reconfiguration, mark a crane slow, and recover a slow crane.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of containers held across the three cranes
always equals the fixed yard total, so no container is ever created or destroyed
by a move, an epoch reconfiguration, or a slow-crane transition.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m4p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, MaxCap
VARIABLES qlen, cap, lockOwner, inCS

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
    /\ qlen \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ lockOwner \in Workers \cup {None}
    /\ inCS \subseteq Workers

Init ==
    /\ qlen = 0
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ lockOwner = None
    /\ inCS = {}

Enqueue ==
    /\ qlen < cap
    /\ qlen' = qlen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, lockOwner, inCS>>

Acquire(w) ==
    /\ lockOwner = None
    /\ lockOwner' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, cap, inCS>>

Process(w) ==
    /\ lockOwner = w
    /\ qlen >= 1
    /\ w \notin inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \cup {w}
    /\ qlen' = qlen - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, lockOwner>>

Finish(w) ==
    /\ w \in inCS
    /\ inCS' = inCS \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, cap, lockOwner>>

Release(w) ==
    /\ lockOwner = w
    /\ w \notin inCS
    /\ lockOwner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, cap, inCS>>

Grow ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, lockOwner, inCS>>

Shrink ==
    /\ cap > 1
    /\ cap > qlen
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<qlen, lockOwner, inCS>>

a fresh snapshot, retry a stale snapshot, finalize a validated enrollment, release
a validated attempt, and admin-enroll a student.

instances, A and B, that share one pool of doses and one physical dispensing

shared lock version. A free instance snapshots the current lock version; other
activity may bump the version. To acquire the head an instance must find its

    /\ ttl[m] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![m] = ttl[m] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, slow, log>>

    /\ ttl[m] = 0
    /\ owner[m] # None
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![m] = None]

    /\ owner[m] = o
    /\ ttl[m] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![m] = MaxTTL]

    /\ ttl[m] > 0
    /\ m \notin Range(log)
    /\ log' = Append(log, m)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, owner, slow>>

    /\ slow' = slow \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, owner, log>>

    \/ \E m \in Machines : Expire(m)

A vending machine network assigns each machine to an operator through a
lease-based ownership scheme with expiry. Leasing a free machine installs an
operator and sets the machine's lease time-to-live to its maximum. Lease time

recovers. When a machine's time-to-live reaches zero its lease can expire and the

maximum. Vending a machine is irreversible: an operator holding a live lease may
record a completed vend for that machine, but only if that machine has not
already vended. A machine can be marked slow and can later recover.

zero-time lease, renew a live lease, vend under a live lease, mark a machine slow,
and recover a slow machine.

irreversible vend of any given machine happens at most once.

protected by a compare-and-swap register that carries a version number. A writer

    /\ proposer' = None

    /\ stage' = "idle"
    /\ proposer' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, ctrlEpoch, votes>>

    /\ proposer' = None

nl:

among signal controllers, under a current authority epoch. The system epoch can
advance during a reconfiguration (only while idle). Each controller carries its
own last-known epoch and can refresh it to the current epoch. Only a controller
whose epoch is current may propose a block-state change; once proposed, every
controller votes yes or no. The change is granted only if it reaches a quorum of
yes votes and the proposer's epoch is still current at grant time; otherwise, on
any no vote or if the proposer has gone stale, the change is denied. A granted
change is applied and the system returns to idle. A privileged admin override may
grant a change directly without a vote and without a proposer.

change as a current controller, cast a vote, grant on quorum with a fresh
proposer, deny on a no vote or a stale proposer, apply a granted change, and
admin-grant without a vote.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a controller-proposed change is in the granted state,
that proposer's epoch equals the current system epoch, so no stale or
unauthorized controller ever has its action granted.

serviced in any order. Granting a lease on a free car installs the dispatcher and
sets the car's lease time-to-live to its maximum; the lease decays over time and,
once it reaches zero, can expire and free the car. A dispatcher holding a live
lease on a car may board one passenger, moving them from the lobby into the cars,

alight a passenger under a live lease.

EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Relays, Controllers, MaxTTL
VARIABLES lease, ttl, ctrlOp, adminOp

    /\ ttl \in [Relays -> 0..MaxTTL]
    /\ ctrlOp \in [Relays -> Controllers \cup {None}]
    /\ adminOp \in [Relays -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ lease = [r \in Relays |-> None]
    /\ ttl = [r \in Relays |-> 0]
    /\ ctrlOp = [r \in Relays |-> None]
    /\ adminOp = [r \in Relays |-> FALSE]

GrantLease(c, r) ==
    /\ lease[r] = None
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![r] = MaxTTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrlOp, adminOp>>

Decay(r) ==
    /\ ttl[r] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![r] = ttl[r] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ctrlOp, adminOp>>

Expire(r) ==
    /\ ttl[r] = 0
    /\ lease[r] # None
    /\ ctrlOp[r] = None
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, ctrlOp, adminOp>>

Operate(c, r) ==
    /\ lease[r] = c
    /\ ttl[r] > 0
    /\ ctrlOp[r] = None
    /\ ~adminOp[r]
    /\ ctrlOp' = [ctrlOp EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, adminOp>>

StopOperate(c, r) ==
    /\ ctrlOp[r] = c
    /\ ctrlOp' = [ctrlOp EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, adminOp>>

AdminOperate(r) ==
    /\ ctrlOp[r] = None
    /\ ~adminOp[r]
    /\ adminOp' = [adminOp EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, ctrlOp>>

AdminStop(r) ==
    /\ adminOp[r]
    /\ adminOp' = [adminOp EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, ctrlOp>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Relays : GrantLease(c, r)
    \/ \E r \in Relays : Decay(r)
    \/ \E r \in Relays : Expire(r)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Relays : Operate(c, r)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Relays : StopOperate(c, r)
    \/ \E r \in Relays : AdminOperate(r)
    \/ \E r \in Relays : AdminStop(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<lease, ttl, ctrlOp, adminOp>>

nl:
A power-grid load shedder controls a set of shedding relays. Each relay is a
critical resource that must be operated by only one actor at a time. Controllers
obtain exclusive control through lease-based ownership with expiry: granting a
lease on a free relay installs a controller and sets the relay's lease
time-to-live to its maximum, the lease decays over time, and once it reaches zero
and the relay is idle the lease can expire and free the relay. A controller
holding a live lease may operate the relay only when no one else is operating it,
and later stops operating. A privileged admin override may operate a relay
directly, but only while no controller is operating it; the admin later stops.

Actions: grant a relay lease, decay a lease, expire a zero-time lease on an idle
relay, operate a relay under a live lease when it is free, stop operating,
admin-operate a free relay, and admin-stop.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For every relay, a controller and the admin override are never
both operating it at the same time, so the critical relay is under the exclusive
control of at most one actor.
